spatial_outer_folds.rule: repeatedly split the largest node group at its response-independent coordinate median on the axis with the larger spatial span; fold IDs follow binary split path order
spatial_outer_folds.ecological_interpretation: evaluation partitions only; never ecological barriers/worlds

effort_context.phase_assignment: within each placename, sort the three frozen deployments by start_date ascending
effort_context.eligibility_rule: deployment has parseable start_date and end_date and end_date > start_date

observation_contract.endpoint_name: Algar placename x deployment phase focal-taxon recorded detection
observation_contract.positive_semantics: after a separately authorized complete response source is frozen, at least one focal-taxon detection linked to the eligible node-context
observation_contract.negative_semantics: after complete authorized response parsing, an otherwise eligible node-context with no focal-taxon detection is a recorded camera non-detection only
observation_contract.unavailable_semantics: response-independent unsurveyed node-contexts are outside the scored endpoint
observation_contract.zero_interpretation: surveyed camera non-detection, never biological absence outside the sampled deployment

predictive_state.source_policy: all previously observed positive nodes aggregated symmetrically

predictive_evaluation.reason: focal endpoint and immutable public response source are not yet frozen

next_if_manifest_pass: metadata-only resolve immutable Dryad response file roster, then freeze one focal endpoint/evaluation/count gate before any response payload access
